notation: Mermaid flowchart: UML-style use cases, processes and responsibility lanes; not native UML/BPMN

UC-01.title: Sign in, resume access and sign out
UC-01.outcome: An authenticated, role-scoped session or a clear rejection.
UC-01.note: Household owner selection and mobile device binding can restrict the session before operational actions.

UC-02.title: Maintain own profile and password
UC-02.outcome: Permitted personal fields or credentials updated.
UC-02.note: These are role-specific entry points, not permission for every actor to call every listed route.

UC-03.title: Recover account access
UC-03.note: Security-question recovery and household SMS recovery are different branches; configured contact data, expiry and throttles apply.

UC-04.title: Manage rescuer accounts and teams
UC-04.outcome: Validated account/team changes with audit evidence.
UC-04.note: Personnel access is currently Operations/Admin; a team leader is not automatically a personnel administrator.

UC-05.title: Manage HQ accounts and roles
UC-05.outcome: Account roles and permitted capabilities configured.
UC-05.note: Role configuration remains bounded by the server policy.

UC-07A.title: Submit a public inquiry
UC-07A.note: Public submission does not grant staff review access.

UC-07B.title: Review and archive inquiries
UC-07B.outcome: Staff handling state and history recorded.

UC-08.title: Select phone owner and complete household setup
UC-08.outcome: Current phone is linked to an authorized household member and setup/geotag.
UC-08.note: Pending-owner tokens cannot perform ordinary household actions. Existing registered Android/iOS platform is preserved.

UC-09.title: Receive and review disaster alerts
UC-09.outcome: App reads stored alerts; eligible devices can receive provider pushes.
UC-09.note: Notification permission, native build, subscription and network availability are required for push delivery.

UC-10.title: Report household or member safety
UC-10.note: Use the active event and actual configured database/broadcast status choices.

UC-11.title: Connect and assist a trusted household
UC-11.outcome: A permitted trusted connection can report scoped member status.
UC-11.note: A household ID alone is insufficient: connection state and PIN/permission checks apply.

UC-12.title: View evacuation information and available directions
UC-12.note: Availability of directions depends on the implemented client, location/provider data and connectivity; do not infer a dedicated household route API.

UC-13B.title: Verify evacuation arrival
UC-13B.outcome: Authorized verification/check-in updates shared evacuation evidence.
UC-13B.note: Backend verifier access is supported; a dedicated scanner account role or complete staff scanning UI is not established by these routes.

UC-14.title: View saved household information offline
UC-14.outcome: An available account-scoped cached overview can be shown.
UC-14.note: Current useMobileOverview/mobileSnapshot supports cached reading. This does not establish durable offline household status submission.

UC-15.title: View own assigned incidents and households
UC-15.outcome: Only the authorized rescuer assignment/household scope is returned.

UC-16.title: Navigate and update assigned mission progress
UC-16.outcome: Permitted route, progress and foreground location updates recorded.
UC-16.note: Active-event, assignment ownership, household queue and valid transition rules apply. Mobile completion is not equivalent to the HQ approval endpoint.

UC-17.title: Use saved navigation and synchronize trip events
UC-17.outcome: Supported local trip events receive server acknowledgments after reconnect.
UC-17.note: Conditional on native storage, valid cached route/pack and device binding. Never generalize this outbox to every mobile write.

UC-19.title: Submit field findings and damage assessment
UC-19.outcome: Validated report header, member assessment and catalog damage choice stored.
UC-19.note: Actual database keys/labels, assignment/event scope and retry protections are used.

UC-20A.title: Communicate using internet PTT and clips
UC-20A.outcome: Internet radio activity and playable clip references recorded.
UC-20A.note: Requires connectivity and microphone access. It is not offline hardware radio; audio files are outside MySQL.

UC-20B.title: Monitor rescue communications
UC-20B.outcome: Authorized HQ can review operational communication metadata.

UC-21A.title: Submit a field logistics request
UC-21A.note: Submission is team-leader-only. Base rescuer identity alone does not grant this POST action.

UC-21B.title: Track or cancel an eligible own request
UC-21B.outcome: Own request state shown or an allowed cancellation recorded.
UC-21B.note: Ownership and current state limit cancellation.

UC-22A.title: Monitor dashboard and operational summaries
UC-22A.outcome: Charts/KPIs derive from selected operational database records.

UC-23A.title: Declare a disaster and publish alert instructions
UC-23A.outcome: Event/alert saved; actual provider delivery state recorded.
UC-23A.note: Publishing is Chairperson/Operations-Admin under current policy. A saved alert can still have no recipients or provider failure; only accepted messages have provider IDs.

UC-23B.title: Review, update and close an active event
UC-23B.note: Close/review/update follow their actual route actions; do not assume all publication permissions are identical.

UC-24.title: Review severity and hazard overlays
UC-24.note: This use case does not claim an implemented arbitrary area-drawing or hazard-edit UI.

UC-25A.title: Review household safety reports
UC-25A.outcome: Household safety data shown within geographic scope.

UC-26A.title: Inspect rescue priorities and historical criteria
UC-26A.outcome: Database-backed priorities and versioned evidence displayed.

UC-26B.title: Dispatch a rescue team
UC-26B.outcome: Validated assignment targets and team/responder scope saved.

UC-26C.title: Complete a dispatch through HQ approval
UC-26C.note: HQ completion is an approve action, distinct from rescuer household-queue progress.

UC-27.title: Monitor field reports and team progress

UC-28.title: Prepare, save and export a situation report
UC-28.outcome: Report created/exported from recorded data and operator inputs.

UC-29.title: Export findings for manual escalation
UC-29.outcome: Exported document available for manual handoff.
UC-29.note: File export does not establish automatic transmission to every higher-level authority.

UC-30.title: Browse, export and manage scoped archive evidence
UC-30.outcome: Authorized archive evidence reviewed or managed.
UC-30.note: Use record IDs, source validation and recording availability. Destructive actions still require their own validation/confirmation.

UC-31.title: Submit an external resource request
UC-31.outcome: Authenticated partner request enters the persisted workflow.
UC-31.note: Partner authentication/contract validation is separate from human sign-in.

UC-32A.title: Review and record resource requests
UC-32A.outcome: Authorized workspace or request record returned.

UC-32B.title: Validate, return or complete a resource request
UC-32B.note: Module visibility does not confer approval. Status labels come from actual lookup records.

UC-33.title: Forward a validated request and monitor fulfillment
UC-33.outcome: Partner handoff/reference and actual fulfillment evidence recorded.
UC-33.note: Partner connectivity/acknowledgment is conditional. Forwarded does not mean delivered.

UC-34A.title: Request a Resqperation report
UC-34A.outcome: Valid partner contract creates a pending report request.
UC-34A.note: Current ReportExchangeController requires contract v4.0 with permitted event, sitio, sections and format.

UC-34B.title: Decide report release and generate a signed file
UC-34B.outcome: Accepted snapshot/file or rejection reason persisted.
UC-34B.note: This is governed by the reports module, not automatically the resource-request approve permission.

UC-35.title: Request and review a partner report
UC-35.outcome: Available partner report returned or explicit provider error.

UC-36.title: Export selected situation findings
UC-36.outcome: Permitted sections exported in the implemented format.

UC-37.title: Register a permitted mobile push subscription
UC-37.outcome: Real subscription/permission/identity saved on the active backend.
UC-37.note: Native SDK registration and consent required. Legacy mobile platforms are used for Android only after provider verification.

UC-38.title: Report safety through a configured SMS gateway
UC-38.outcome: A verified sender can record supported event status.
UC-38.note: Gateway signature/timestamp, matching household contact, active event and supported keyword are required.

UC-39.title: Review notifications and enable browser push
UC-39.outcome: Authorized web notifications or browser subscription updated.
UC-39.note: Browser push uses VAPID/service-worker configuration and HTTPS requirements; it is separate from mobile OneSignal.
